permission_denied.title: Home Assistant cannot open the port of {title}
permission_denied.description:
The {title} counter is configured on {port}, but Home Assistant is not allowed to open it.

This happens on Home Assistant Core installations when the user running Home Assistant is not in the group owning serial ports, usually `dialout`. Add it, for example with `sudo usermod -aG dialout homeassistant`, then restart Home Assistant.

This issue clears itself once the counter can be read.

device_mismatch.title: Wrong counter on the port of {title}
device_mismatch.description:
The counter answering on {port} has serial number {serial_number}, which is not the counter {title} was set up with.

This happens when counters are swapped, or when several adapters of the same kind share one /dev/serial/by-id/ path. Plug in the right counter, or use **Reconfigure** on {title} to select its new port. To use the other counter as well, add it as a new device.

This issue clears itself once the right counter answers.
